source.title: 社畜トレイン(Shachiku Train)
source.author: しゑひ(shiwehi)
source.fetch_method: curl through the session proxy, TLS verification ON, with --cacert naming a bundle that adds the Let's Encrypt YE2 intermediate (shiwehi.com omits it from its chain), the method STSD, STMB Cave, インペリアルクロス, ダブルダガー, BT砲, 千鳥格子, 山岳積み2号 and stick spin used. The snapshot is the page's raw HTML, byte for byte; every board is plain text in it, 13 ten-wide boards in page order.
source.snapshot_note: sha256 of the raw HTML this transcription was checked against. Not re-verifiable in CI: the page is not committed and cannot be fetched there. Re-check with --html-dir after any refetch (with harddrop's Shachiku_Train.wikitext and STMB_Cave.wikitext beside it); an HTML hash moves with ANY byte of the page (ads, sidebar, a date), so a moved hash means "read the board diff", not "the boards changed". Sentences are compared against the page with its tags dropped.

quotes.verbatim: ここでは、社畜トレイン(Shachiku Train)という、TSDを2回打つドネイトについて紹介していきます。
基本形と組み方・ラインの消し方
下図のように%S%Lを用いてTSDの形を打ち、その後%Zで屋根を付けてもう一度TSDを打ちます。
4x2の窪みが空いていれば段を組みつつ打つことができます。
下穴が2x2マス空いているときの社畜トレイン
下穴が2x2マス空いているときに社畜トレインを打つことで、STSDの地形が現れます。
また、下穴の形によってはTSTの地形が現れます。
開幕DT砲からの社畜トレイン(DT社畜)
開幕DT砲からの派生の1つとして社畜トレインを組むこともできます。
%S%Zが早い時に下図のようにすることで組むことができます。

nodes.label: the basic form's terrain: a stack to the left, two rows deep beside it, a well at the right wall
an S one column off the stack, an L hung over its far end, and the T laid flat, pointing down, under the stack's roof: a TSD
what the TSD leaves, a Z roofing the second slot, and the second T laid flat into it: a second TSD (the page draws this board, not the one before the Z)
a hollow four wide and two deep
the S and L in the hollow, a pale S, a J and an O stacked around them, and the T laid flat: a TSD
what the TSD leaves, an I against the wall and a Z roofing the second slot, and the second T in it
a hole two wide and two deep under the slot's row
an O against the wall, the S and L, a Z roofing the T's near end, and the T laid flat: a TSD
what the TSD leaves: the S's foot over the hole, an STSD's terrain
the same, with one more cell filled at the hole's bottom
the same build and TSD over it
what the TSD leaves: a TST's terrain
DT社畜: from the DT砲 opener with S and Z early, a J and a Z against the wall, an S hung over the slot (mirrored; no T drawn)

variants.window_note: in basic.spin's frame, row 0 the top: the AGREEMENT BOX of this page's drawings of the shape and harddrop's Shachiku_Train drawings. Row 1 is the row above the T: the roof over its near end and the cell beyond it filled, the cell over its middle and the second slot's arms empty; rows 2-3 are the rows the TSD clears (entailed by the clear at a full TSD, NaiveClauseForced); row 4 is the row under them: the cell under the nub and the S's foot filled, the second slot's nub cell empty, the L's foot beyond it filled. The second slot's roof (the Z) is outside: the page places it after the first TSD. Occupancy only, never colour; garbage is filled.

followup.note: the flat T, pointing down, into the second slot. Before the TSD its cells are split by the two cleared rows (its arms above them, its nub under them); the TSD joins them, the Z roofs them, and the matcher carries the slot through every later clear to the next T.

not_expressed.reason: the page's next step is the STSD whose terrain the TSD uncovers, not the second TSD: the cell under the follow-up slot's nub is the open 2x2 hole, the page draws no roof and no stack beside the slot's arms (the follow-up T fills one row of the drawn after board, a TSD two), and STSD's own window fires nowhere on it (its roof is not built yet). A hit on this terrain is still a hit, counted with the follow-up's own outcome; the STSD is the STSD page's

the page's next step is the TST whose terrain the TSD uncovers, not the second TSD: the cell under the follow-up slot's nub is open, the page draws no roof and no stack beside the slot's arms (the follow-up T fills one row of the drawn after board), and STSD's window fires nowhere on it either. A TST has no window on this page

the build keeps the DT砲's hole under the follow-up slot's nub (open three rows down, mirrored), and the drawing stops there: its L shows three cells, the fourth under the bottom edge. What the page builds next from the DT砲 is not drawn, so nothing past the second TSD is read
